# nebula_ca_bundle (Data Source)

Concatenates Nebula CA certificates into one bundle for Nebula's `pki.ca`, checking that each is a correctly self-signed CA. Duplicates are dropped and expired CAs are left out with a warning. Needs no OpenBao/Vault access. Use it to trust an old and a new CA during rotation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Trust the current and the next CA while rotating.
data "nebula_ca_bundle" "trusted" {
  ca_certs_pem = [
    nebula_ca.current.cert_pem,
    nebula_ca.next.cert_pem,
  ]
}

# Use data.nebula_ca_bundle.trusted.bundle_pem as Nebula's pki.ca.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ca_certs_pem` (List of String) CA certificates in Nebula PEM format. An element may itself hold several certificates.

### Read-Only

- `bundle_pem` (String) The CA certificates, in input order, without duplicates or expired CAs.
- `fingerprints` (List of String) Fingerprints of the CAs in `bundle_pem`, in the same order.
- `id` (String) The fingerprints joined with commas.
